Auditor model family is not the preparer

identity distinct from the GPT controller

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tool allow-list: NO memory.facts, memory.policies,
memory.similar_decisions (no why-it-is-fine notes) ·
NO propose_entry, no fact or policy write ·
only the non-posting audit.write_finding

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Forms its view from evidence and workpapers
BEFORE it may read preparer judgment notes ·
sample seed never visible to preparers · sample size
falls only on own control tests, never on replay agreement

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
audit.fact_provenance(fact_id) only: tests
the fact as a control · approver had authority,
in scope, valid on date, quote is a substring

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
May never suppress a screen: no fact can
disable one · an explained hit is annotated
and STAYS eligible for selection

shared read for every OTHER function ·
NOT in the auditor allow-list: no read path

audit.control_test · ledger.* · bank.*

completeness, cutoff, accuracy, authorisation
= all gl_entry in the period, definition_json

= closing TB per account · entry id sequence has
no gaps · every entry has source_decision_id

frozen and immutable after selection

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Carve out 100 percent items: entry gte tolerable
misstatement or gte sampling interval, examined
in full, NOT part of the sample (AS 2315.21)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Monetary-unit (PPS, AS 2315 fn 4) lane: n = ceil(BV x
factor / tolerable) · factor 3.0 = 95 percent, zero expected
misstatement (AICPA table, UNVERIFIED) · interval = BV / n ·
random start · walk cumulative abs cents

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Risk-based / judgmental lane: every entry that hit
a stage 4 screen, selection_reason = screen name ·
NOT a representative sample: never projected to the
population, reported separately (follows AS 2315.24)

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
audit_sample (population_id, method, seed,
params_json) + audit_item (gl_entry_id,
selection_reason, stratum) · n stated per lane

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
audit.rerun_kernel(decision_id): re-fetch
evidence from the trace store by trace_id,
never the preparer cached quotes

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
E: every quote re-verified as a substring
of its versioned trace payload · every
trace_id still exists

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
F: every sum re-footed in integer cents:
debits = credits · applications fit ·
schedule sums · subledger = GL control

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
P: approval re-checked vs the approval matrix
AS OF the posting date: approver is not actor,
limit_cents gte amount, period was open

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
J: each policy approved and each fact active
and in scope on the entry date, checked
through audit.fact_provenance only

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
evidence_hash_then vs evidence_hash_now:
evidence changed since posting ?
(H-6, F-06, A-24) yes → finding

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
reperformance (item_id, original_verdict,
rerun_verdict, mark_diffs_json, evidence_hash_then,
evidence_hash_now) · re-run marks diffed
against workpaper.marks_json

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Screen runner: every entry.posted and
entry.blocked, plus a full-period sweep
at close.period.locked

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Duplicate vendors via entity resolution (track
doc, B-18): normalise case, suffixes, NBSP (F-13) ·
block on tax_id, bank_hash, phone, address

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Jaro-Winkler on name + exact bank or tax hit ·
same bank_hash, different name = always a hit ·
gt 0.95 code · 0.85-0.95 model · below dropped

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Round-number payments (track doc):
amount_cents mod 100000 = 0, or
mod 10000 = 0 above materiality

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Posted after the period closed (track doc):
posted_at gt period.locked_at, date in locked period
posted_at, locked_at: PROPOSED SCHEMA ADDITION

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Self-approved request (track doc, G-02):
approval.approver = decision.actor, or approver =
vendor.created_by · approval table is proposed

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weekend or late-night posting: posted_at on
Sat/Sun or outside 07:00-20:00 local · weighted
toward period end (AS 2401.62) · also thin memo
(under 15 chars on a manual entry)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Unusual account pair: (debit, credit) account
frequency over Q2 + July below 1st percentile,
or never seen

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Accrual with no reversal (D-02): kind accrual
flagged to reverse, no reversing gl_entry
by day 5 of the next period

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Learned rule fired above its approver ceiling
(G-04): policy.approved_by limit_cents
lt entry amount

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Blocked-attempts log review (G-01, H-1):
every blocked_attempt has rule name, approver
click, original payment and bank line

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STRETCH: Benford first-digit screen, MAD and
chi-square vs log10(1 + 1/d) · n of order 1,000
(floor UNVERIFIED, secondary source) · Northwind has
10 vendors → prints insufficient n, not a verdict

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Screen hit list: gl_entry_id, screen, detail ·
hits are annotated, never deleted ·
feeds the risk-based lane

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Attribute sampling per control: n from the
tolerable deviation rate · count deviations
(AS 2315.31-.43) · n stated

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Segregation of duties (COSO P10, G-02)
Design: storage layer rejects preparer = approver
Operating: n approvals, approver vs decision.actor

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Approval limits (B-24, G-04)
Design: matrix in memo, rule inherits ceiling
Operating: n entries, limit_cents gte amount

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Period lock (G-03)
Design: kernel P mark period open
Operating: 0 post-close hits + block rows exist

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Three-way match operating (AP)
Design: kernel E mark within tolerance
Operating: n paid bills re-matched to po, receipt

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bank-detail change verification (B-17)
Design: email change refused, out-of-band confirm
Operating: each ap.vendor.change_requested has a confirm trace

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Asked once: no repeat questions
Design: answer → scoped fact applied by code
Operating: escalation rows, same party + predicate = 0

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Departed employee holds no approval authority
(consumes hr.departure_detected)
Operating: approvals dated after end_date = 0

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
control_test (id, control_id, period, attribute,
n_tested, deviations) + sample evidence refs ·
deviations compared to the tolerable deviation rate

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CODE evaluates: project misstatement from the
random and MUS lanes only (AS 2315.26) + actual
misstatement in 100 percent items, vs tolerable
misstatement · classify each exception

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MODEL: business-rationale read of a screen hit:
does a contract or PO in the trace store explain
it ? must quote it · no quote = no clearance

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MODEL: borderline vendor cluster (0.85-0.95):
same legal entity ? must cite the
matching fields

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CODE fills condition, criteria and effect
amounts from audit_item, reperformance
and control_test rows

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MODEL writes cause and recommendation only
(IIA five attributes) · must cite gl_entry.id,
trace_id and a quote · recorded as judgment

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CODE walks the chain by id: artifact →
decision → workpaper mark → evidence quote
in trace → approval.approver

div.style: color: rgb(37, 16, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
audit.write_finding + workpaper
(the auditor non-posting stand-in for
propose_entry + workpaper)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Kernel F·E·P·J + pack checks

div.style: color: rgb(59, 9, 6) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pack checks: population hash unchanged · sample
reproducible from seed · projection recomputed ·
finding cites existing ids, quotes are substrings ·
auditor is not preparer, reviewer or approver

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
finding (control_id, condition, criteria, cause,
effect, recommendation, severity, item_ids_json,
status) · closes only with a remediation decision

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No exception: re-performs identically → tick,
re-performance workpaper, evidence pack entry ·
round amount backed by a PO quote: annotated

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exception immaterial: logged finding, low severity,
nobody paged · D-10 counter + 1 (third same-sign
period in a fraud-sensitive account escalates)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Exception material, mark differs or evidence
hash changed (H-6, F-06, A-24): finding +
downstream state invalidated

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Control failure (self-approved entry found posted,
deviations gt tolerable, block row missing):
high-severity finding + autonomy demotion

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Duplicate vendor cluster or near-duplicate
payment across it (B-18, B-14): cluster report
with both payment histories

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Attempt to post to a locked period, self-approve
or exceed a limit: BLOCK already persisted by the
kernel · audit confirms the blocked_attempt row

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Population fails completeness:
cannot audit, population does not tie,
differences listed

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Remediation: audit.finding.raised opens an intent
in the owning function · it corrects via its own
propose_entry in the current open period ·
human approves with the finding attached

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Controller

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CFO (never the approver
under test)

div.style: color: rgb(63, 37, 3) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: AP owner / close owner

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: AUTO

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: PROPOSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: ESCALATE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: REFUSE

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: BLOCK

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Per balance-sheet
account

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tie-out sheet: GL balance
= subledger, bank or schedule

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Workpapers + re-performance
diffs + approvals

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Source documents:
trace copies with sha256

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
pbc_pack (id, period, manifest_json, sha256)
+ population file and hash, sample seed and
params, control matrix, findings

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
event (ts, topic, from_function = audit,
intent_id, payload_json)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
topic audit.finding.raised
(severity, control_id, item_ids)

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
topics audit.pack.ready (pbc_pack id, sha256)
and audit.evidence.invalidated
(decision_id, trace_id, hashes)

div.style: color: rgb(53, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
checklist_item for the close: audit findings
reviewed · blocked_reason while a high-severity
finding is open · pack ready ticks it

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Learning loops: each finding becomes a new
regression case in the replay suite run as CI
(and a planted-exception recall check)

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Autonomy ladder: that decision kind demoted
to post-with-review or shadow until replay
agreement and n are re-earned

div.style: color: rgb(6, 43, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Learnable by the auditor: confirmed vendor alias
clusters (AP-owned master data), account-pair
baseline, screen weights · NEVER a suppression

div.style: color: rgb(12, 46, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Metrics, TO BE MEASURED (nothing run yet): sample
size n by lane · re-performance pass rate · findings
by severity · checkable fraction re-verified · control
tests passed of n · blocks verified / attempted
